title: Document key architecture decisions
description:
Capture and track the key Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) from docs/DECISIONS.md:

- ADR-001: Electron desktop application (chosen over Next.js SPA or Tauri for local-first control and Node/TypeScript depth)
- ADR-002: TypeScript/Node runtime first, no Python service (single runtime, simpler debugging, faster iteration)
- ADR-003: SQLite for all persistence (zero external dependencies, single file, includes vector storage via sqlite-vec)

Each ADR includes context, decision, alternatives considered, consequences, and revisit conditions. These decisions shape the Artemis Lite architecture and should be revisited when stated conditions are met.
